meta.scope: Post-1956 rebel/armed-group areas of control by date (staging)
meta.author: Sudan Geopolitical Analyst
meta.rules: All records CONTESTED; APPROXIMATE where area vague. Dates as stated by source (date of report where the source gives only a state at that date). geometry null throughout: no source gave verifiable coordinates/boundaries. place_id only if in db/cities*.json. 2003+ UN/OCHA/ACLED only. Arabic = working translations [يحتاج تحقق]. Quotes verbatim from pages opened 2026-10-26. No fatality figures.
gaps: Anyanya 1955-72: no UN or academic text opened that states areas of Anyanya control; zero records

records.area_ar: مقر القوات المسلحة، نيالا (استولى عليه الدعم السريع) [يحتاج تحقق]

citation.quote: RSF successively captured SAF headquarters in South Darfur (Nyala on 26 October), Central Darfur (Zalingei on 31 October), West Darfur (Ardamatta on 4 November) and East Darfur (Ed Daein on 22 November) (see table 1). SAF retained a presence only in North Darfur State, in particular at its headquarters in El Fasher.

The RSF captured Bara city in North Kordofan on 25 October.
